name: Welcome to the Synbio Skill Tree
description: How to navigate this project-based synthetic biology curriculum and set up for success.

children.name: The Sterile Workspace
children.description: Set up PPE, a Bunsen 'cone of protection', and a media-sterilisation strategy.

children.name: DIY Buffer Mixing
children.description: Mix your own buffers safely to cut costs - or buy pre-mixed if working solo.

children.name: Mixing Media & Pouring Plates
children.description: Mix LB media/agar, pour plates, and make antibiotic selection plates.

children.name: Sterile (Aseptic) Technique
children.description: Master the core discipline of microbiology - plus the inoculating loop and spreader.

children.name: Host Selection Criteria
children.description: Choose a safe, well-characterised, single-celled host - and check it's legal.

children.name: Culturing Conditions
children.description: Know your organism: ideal media, temperature, growth curve and morphology.

children.name: DNA101 (Theory)
children.description: Refresh DNA structure, base pairing and the interactions cloning relies on.

children.name: Purification of Genomic DNA
children.description: Extract genomic DNA - and learn why you'll usually work with plasmids instead.

children.name: RNA Purification
children.description: Extract intact RNA while keeping ubiquitous RNases at bay.

children.name: RT-qPCR
children.description: Reverse-transcribe RNA to cDNA and quantify transcript levels in real time.

children.name: Plasmids101 (Theory)
children.description: Understand plasmids as the programmable 'add-ons' of the cell.

children.name: Backbone Selection (Theory)
children.description: Choose the right plasmid backbone for your first experiments.

children.name: gBlock & Insert Design (Theory)
children.description: Design the perfect synthetic insert - codon optimisation, tags, cut sites.

children.name: Restriction Enzyme Digest
children.description: Cut plasmid and insert with restriction enzymes; plan with a sequence viewer.

children.name: Ligation & Troubleshooting
children.description: Glue DNA with T4 ligase and design the five control plates that save you weeks.

children.name: Confirmation of Edits
children.description: Screen clones with patch plates, colony PCR and restriction-digest analysis.

children.name: Sequencing Prep & Interpretation
children.description: Prepare samples for external (or in-house Nanopore) sequencing and read results.

children.name: Proteins101 (Theory)
children.description: Working knowledge of protein mechanics before producing them in the lab.

children.name: Induction of Protein Expression
children.description: Trigger protein expression at the right growth phase using OD600.

children.name: Cell Lysis
children.description: Bust open cells to release your protein into cell slurry.

children.name: Affinity Tag Purification
children.description: Recover tagged protein from cell slurry (His-tag / Ni-NTA, or Car9/silica).

children.name: SDS-PAGE
children.description: Size and quantify proteins on a denaturing polyacrylamide gel.

children.name: Capstone: Express & Purify a Protein
children.description: Demonstrate mastery end to end: design, build, confirm, express and purify a protein.

children.name: Beyond the Bench: RNA, Omics & Bio-Programming
children.description: The frontier: gene switches, omics, aptamers, mass spec and advanced biological programming.

children.name: Western Blot
children.description: Detect a specific protein by size + antibody after transferring an SDS-PAGE gel to a membrane.

children.name: ELISA
children.description: Quantify a protein/antigen in solution with an antibody-based plate assay.

children.name: CRISPR / Cas9
children.description: Target precise genomic edits with a Cas enzyme and a designed guide RNA.

children.name: Plasmid Miniprep (Ethanol Lysis)
children.description: Purify plasmid DNA via the premier miniprep workflow: lyse, capture, wash, elute.

children.name: Plasmid Insertion (Transformation)
children.description: Get DNA into cells: heat shock, electroporation, or gene guns.

children.name: Agarose Gel Electrophoresis
children.description: Separate and size DNA fragments - your bread-and-butter readout.

children.name: Gel Illumination & Photography
children.description: Capture publication-quality gel images with cheap kit and a smartphone.

children.name: Polymerase Chain Reaction (PCR)
children.description: Amplify any DNA region exponentially with a thermocycler and a master mix.

children.name: Primer Design
children.description: Design primer pairs that bind your template, not each other.

children.name: Gradient PCR
children.description: Find the optimal annealing temperature in a single run.

children.name: Flanking Sequence Addition
children.description: Add restriction sites or assembly overhangs via 5' primer overhangs.

children.name: Gibson Assembly
children.description: Scarless single-tube assembly of up to ~6 fragments via homologous overlaps.

children.name: Golden Gate Assembly
children.description: Type IIS scarless assembly of 10+ ordered fragments in one tube.

children.name: Site-Directed Mutagenesis
children.description: Introduce a precise point mutation via megaprimer or round-the-world PCR.

children.name: THE Micropipette
children.description: Master the single most important tool in the lab: accurate, bubble-free pipetting.

children.name: The Centrifuge
children.description: Pellet cells and clear lysates safely - the workhorse behind minipreps.

children.name: The Thermocycler
children.description: Program the heating/cooling cycles that drive PCR.

children.name: The Spectrophotometer
children.description: Measure OD600 to track cell growth and time induction.
